name: Silkscreen
personality: a square bitmap face that stays crisp at integer sizes
use_for: pixel art, game UI labels, short headings at 16px multiples
avoid: body text; sizes that are not multiples of its pixel grid

name: Caveat
personality: quick, legible handwriting with a ballpoint rhythm
use_for: notes, margin annotations, journal headings at 20px and up
avoid: body copy; anything that must read at a glance
